name: mission-control
description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, a code map of the files they touch, and a card per subagent that opens to its whole conversation, with buttons to show its transcript in the main view or ask it to stop (/radar opens that tab). It opens with each session (the openOnStart option turns that off), and each view scrolls; a crab at the pane's foot acts out what Claude is doing. The band above the prompt sums up the turn and has one live line per running subagent.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Mission Control pane when an interactive session starts, without taking the prompt's focus. A terminal narrower than 144 columns places it once it is wide enough, or on /mission.
